title: Valid Sudoku
prompt: Determine if a 9 x 9 Sudoku board is valid. Only the filled cells need to be validated. A Sudoku board (partially filled) could be valid but is not necessarily solvable. Rules: Each row must contain digits 1-9 without repetition. Each column must contain digits 1-9 without repetition. Each of the nine 3 x 3 sub-boxes must contain digits 1-9 without repetition.
hints: Use sets to track what you've seen in each row, column, and 3x3 box.
For box index: boxIdx = (row/3)*3 + col/3. This maps each cell to one of 9 boxes.
Create 9 sets for rows, 9 for columns, 9 for boxes. Iterate and check for duplicates.
You can use a single pass: for each non-empty cell, check if it already exists in its row/col/box sets.
